title: Maple leaf with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- leaf stem -->
    <rect x="47" y="78" width="6" height="16" rx="3" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
    <!-- main leaf shape -->
    <path d="M50 12 
             L56 28 L64 22 L62 34 L76 28 L70 40 
             L84 42 L74 52 L86 60 L72 58 
             L76 72 L62 64 L58 80 
             L50 70 L42 80 L38 64 L24 72 
             L28 58 L14 60 L26 52 L16 42 
             L30 40 L24 28 L38 34 L36 22 
             L44 28 Z" 
          fill="#E8483B" 
          stroke="#FF7A5C" 
          stroke-width="2.5" 
          stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- leaf veins -->
    <g stroke="#C42E24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
      <line x1="50" y1="70" x2="50" y2="30"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="34" y2="38"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="66" y2="38"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="38" y2="58"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="62" y2="58"/>
    </g>
    <!-- smiling face -->
    <g>
      <!-- eyes -->
      <ellipse cx="42" cy="45" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2E1A0E"/>
      <ellipse cx="58" cy="45" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2E1A0E"/>
      <!-- eye highlights -->
      <circle cx="43.5" cy="43.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFF4D6"/>
      <circle cx="59.5" cy="43.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFF4D6"/>
      <!-- smile -->
      <path d="M40 55 Q50 67 60 55" 
            stroke="#2E1A0E" 
            stroke-width="3" 
            stroke-linecap="round" 
            fill="none"/>
      <!-- rosy cheeks -->
      <circle cx="34" cy="52" r="4" fill="#FF9F8C" opacity="0.7"/>
      <circle cx="66" cy="52" r="4" fill="#FF9F8C" opacity="0.7"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
